broadcasts.message: normalize.js implemented per spec: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. Non-string input returned as-is. No shadowing. Ready for integration.
Tokenizer implemented: normalize then extract alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes. Handles empty string by returning []. Ready for pipeline integration.
Pipeline implemented. It calls injected tokenize, builds first-seen unique list and frequencies using Object.create(null) to avoid prototype collisions. Returns required shape. Ready for integration.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 1: Initial task. I own normalize.js. Must implement normalize(text): NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. Only for string input; otherwise behavior unspecified but should be safe (return input as-is? Spec says 'for string input' so non-string can return as-is). No shadowing injected normalize/tokenize. Peers: tokenizer calls normalize, pipeline calls tokenize. Next rounds may refine edge cases. Keep implementation simple, faithful, no extras.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 1: Implement tokenizer.js with normalize dependency. Extract ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes. Keep order, no stopwords. Ensure no shadowing of normalize/tokenize. Next: review pipeline integration.
private_memories.integrator: Round 1: Starting pipeline.js. Interface: processText(text) -> {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. Dependencies: tokenize injected. Must handle prototype names (constructor). No shadowing. Ensure faithful processing.
